thread:
Sam (sales): Hey team — Kyvernion POC kickoff. Customer sent their security questionnaire and a rough spec: company ~1M users, wants SSO (SAML + IdP-initiated), SCIM for provisioning with delta sync, group-based RBAC mapping, and strict domain claim controls across multiple subdomains. They asked for scoping/pricing for SCIM (bulk + delta), and whether Hosted API can handle sustained SCIM writes or if Dedicated is recommended. Also legal asked about KMS and audit logs. Can we summarize blockers and answers by EOD?

Aisha (solutions): Thanks — can you attach the questionnaire link? Also do they need SCIM pushes from us or pulls from their IdP?

Sam (sales): Uploaded questionnaire: https://files.redwood/kyvernion/sec-questionnaire.pdf. They want us to accept SCIM pushes from their provisioning system to our endpoint (we act as SCIM service). Delta window: 15 minutes preferred. Bulk initial import ~1.2M users.

Diego (eng): Bulk + sustained delta at that scale needs throughput planning. Questions: average users changed per minute, size of payload per user, and whether we need SCIM->DB strong consistency. Default Hosted rate limits will likely throttle them. Dedicated or reserved throughput recommended.

Priya (security): From questionnaire highlights: they require customer-managed KMS or HSM for key wrapping, SOC2 type II evidence, and 12-month audit logs retention. Also need SAML assertion attributes: email, groups, employeeType.

Alex (sales_eng): For pricing note — SCIM provisioning is charged per write-unit for Hosted. For 1.2M initial + 15-min delta we should model steady-state writes. I can run numbers if we get churn rate. Also need to know if they want SCIM to create org-level RBAC roles or just group-to-role mapping.

Sam (sales): They said group->role mapping only, but want delegated admins in the app (subset of groups). Also they asked if domain claim can be delegated per-subdomain (they host app across eu.example.com, us.example.com).

Aisha (solutions): Domain claim: we support multiple verified domains per customer but need DNS TXT proof for each. Delegated claim (by subdomain) is supported with separate verification records. That adds ops steps but doable.

Diego (eng): Technical blockers I see: 1) Hosted API default SCIM rate limits (we have 100 req/s per tenant soft limit). 2) Initial import of 1.2M needs a bulk import job into Dedicated ingestion pipeline to avoid rate-limiting. 3) Group cardinality: if they have >10k groups that mapping may explode ACL checks.

Priya (security): KMS: Hosted can integrate with customer-managed KMS in Private/Dedicated offering; Hosted customers can use our managed KMS but legal might push for BYOK. Need to flag as enterprise-only. Also will need to provide SOC2 artifacts and run a security review.

Alex (sales_eng): Quick proposal: 1) Offer Dedicated Reserved for POC with a short-term burst policy for the initial bulk import. 2) Configure a SCIM ingestion endpoint on Dedicated with a 50% higher write throughput and temporary rate override for the import. 3) Pricing: show delta per-write estimate + one-time bulk ingestion fee. I can draft numbers if Diego confirms expected writes/min.

Sam (sales): Customer asked for a ballpark now. Diego — if we assume 1.2M initial over 6 hours, and steady-state 2k writes/hour (1 user change every ~1.8s), what are the ops impacts?

Diego (eng): 1.2M / 6h =~ 55k users/hour => ~15.3 users/sec. That's fine for Dedicated if we provision ingestion pool. Steady-state 2k/hour =~ 0.56 users/sec — trivial. Main issue is spikes and group expansion. Also delta window 15m means batched syncs; recommend batching in 100-500 user chunks to reduce overhead. Example curl snippet for our SCIM endpoint: 

```
POST /scim/v2/Bulk
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:BulkRequest"],
  "Operations": [ { "method": "POST", "path": "/Users", "data": { "userName": "jane@kyvernion.com", "emails": [{"value":"jane@..."}], "groups": ["eng"] } } ]
}
```

Aisha (solutions): For RBAC mapping: we can accept SCIM group membership -> app roles. Delegated admin mapping we implement via special admin groups (prefix admin:). Need to confirm naming convention.

Sam (sales): I'll ask them to confirm naming. Priya — can we satisfy KMS/Audit asks for POC or do we need Private/Dedicated contract first?

Priya (security): For POC, we can provide limited attestations and use our managed KMS with enhanced logging. Full BYOK/HSM and 12mo archived logs require a Private or Dedicated enterprise agreement. Flagging this for legal.

Alex (sales_eng): Action items: (1) Diego to spec throughput + temp rate override steps, (2) Aisha to write SCIM mapping doc and example group conventions, (3) Priya to prepare a redacted SOC2 summary and KMS options, (4) Sam to ask customer for churn numbers and confirm admin group naming. I'll draft pricing ballpark after Diego's numbers.

Diego (eng): I can deliver throughput spec and recommended Dedicated pool size by EOD. Also will add migration playbook for bulk import (resume tokens, idempotency keys).

Aisha (solutions): I'll put SCIM mapping doc in the POC folder and ping the customer with naming reqs.

Priya (security): I'll attach SOC2 summary + required gating items. Note: if customer insists on BYOK, timeline extends ~3 weeks for key exchange and audit steps.

Sam (sales): Great — thanks. Quick follow-up: they asked whether SCIM deltas must be synchronous or we can accept asynchronous webhooks. They prefer push but ok with asynchronous.

Alex (sales_eng): Either works; for large scale asynchronous with retry/backoff is better. We'll recommend push with 200-range ack and retry window. Document that in mapping doc.

ops-bot: Deployment note — created ticket INF-8342 for Kyvernion POC Dedicated pool provisioning.

Sam (sales): Perfect. I'll update the customer with this plan and ask for churn numbers + admin group names. Will circle back with attachments. :thumbsup:
